Pollution in rivers due to sewage
†*136. SHRI VISHAMBHAR
PRASAD NISHAD: Will the Minister of
W ATER RESOURCES, RIVER
DEVELOPMENT AND GANGA
REJUVENATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that sewage is
directly drained into rivers of the country
including Yamuna river in Delhi and local
water bodies due to which natural water
sources are getting polluted;
(b) whether orders of National Green
Tribunal (NGT) are being complied with
for installation of sewage treatment plants
for treatment of dirty water of urban drains
which is being drained into rivers and water
sources of the country; and
(c) the percentage of water bodies
getting polluted due to direct sewage and
the details of the steps taken to prevent
water sources from getting polluted?
Deforestation and encroachment on
forest land
*137. SHRI ABDUL WAHAB: Will the
Minister of  ENVIRONMENT, FOREST
AND CLIMATE CHANGE  be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of complaints received
by the Ministry on cutting down of trees
and encroachment of forest land in many
States including Kerala; and
(b) the details of action taken thereon?
Compliance with DPP
*138. SHRI NEERAJ SHEKHAR:
Will the Minister of  DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of the Defence
Procurement Procedure (DPP) to be
followed by Government for a defence deal
with other countries; and
(b) the details of the defence deals since
2014 in which Defence Procurement

Procedures have not been followed, along
with the reasons therefor, deal-wise?
Mining University and Courses in the
country
*139. SHRI AMAR SHANKAR
SABLE: Will the Minister of  MINES be
pleased to state:
(a)  details of the mining courses in India;
(b) whether the Government has any
plan to open new mining university in the
country; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Encroachment on National Highways
*140. SHRI SHAMSHER SINGH
DULLO: Will the Minister of ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that most of the
National Highways are vulnerable to
encroachments which result in the frequent
road accidents;
(b) details of steps taken by
Government to remove such
encroachments on the National Highways;
(c) the number of National Highways
which have been cleared from
encroachments during the last three years;
and
(d) whether it is a fact that National
Highway passing through the State of
Punjab is full of encroachments, if so, steps
taken by Government to remove such
encroachments identified by the National
Highways Authority of India?
Pucca houses under PMAY
*141. SHRI DEREK O’BRIEN: Will
the Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that only 42 per
cent of all rural houses are fully pucca as
against 86 per cent in urban areas, if so,
the details thereof;
(b) the percentage of newly constructed
pucca houses under Pradhan Mantri Awas
Yojana (PMAY), rural and urban
respectively;
(c) whether the Ministry has set any
targets for conversion of all kutcha houses
into pucca houses in both rural and urban
areas, if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Fund allocation for dam safety
*142. SHRI AHAMED HASSAN: Will
the Minister of W ATER RESOURCES,
RIVER DEVELOPMENT AND GANGA
REJUVENATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has sanctioned
extra funds for dam safety projects in the
country, since 2014;
(b) if so, allocation for the period 2015
to 2018, project-wise;
(c) whether Government has devised
any strategy for the rehabilitation of
marginal farmers; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Development of National Waterways
*143. SHRI V . MURALEEDHARAN:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of development of
National Waterways during the period from
2014 to 2018;

(c) whether any proposal has been

development of National Waterways in the
State; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

De-blacklisting of Agusta Westland
1441. SHRI NEERAJ SHEKHAR:
SHRI RA VI PRAKASH
VERMA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Agusta Westland and its
parent company Finmeccanica were
blacklisted by previous Government after
reports of VVIP Helicopter Scam;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether present Government
allowed the blacklisted company to
participate in the bid for Naval Utility
helicopters; and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor?
Air Force rescue operations during
Kerala floods
1442. SHRI D. RAJA: Will the Minister
of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Kerala
Government has been asked to pay about
` 34 crore for using the services of small
planes and helicopters of the Air Force in
the rescue operation during the recent floods
in the State; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Status of the 'Ghatak' combat drones
1443. SHRI A.K. SELV ARAJ: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Ghatak
project of stealth combat drones with initial
corpus of  ` 2650 crore, is years away
from completion;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government has fixed any
target to complete the said project now; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

334
Applicability of Defence Production
Policy
1444. PROF. M.V . RAJEEV GOWDA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) the procurement and production
policy that will be applicable in the
purchase of 114 new planes with respect
to the determination of eligible Indian
Offset Partners;
(b) whether the provisions of the Draft
Defence Production Policy, 2018 will
apply retrospectively; and
(c) if so,  details for the same?
De-blacklisting of Agusta Westland/
Finmeccanica
1445. DR. SANJAY SINH: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in 2014, the
UPA Government initiated proceedings to
blacklist Agusta Westland and its parent
company, Finmeccanica and both
companies were blacklisted;
(b) whether it is a fact that UPA
Government also filed a case against Agusta
Westland in Milan, Italy and on May 23,
2014, the UPA Government won the case
for encashment of  international guarantees
of Agusta Westland to recover Euro
2,28,00,00,00; and
(c) if so, reason for permitting blacklisted
Agusta Westland/Finmeccanica  Company
to get clearances from Foreign Investment
Promotion Board (FIPB) and permit its
entry as partner or sub-contractor to various
Indian corporates?
Performance of DRDO
1446. SHRI R. V AITHILINGAM: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India
continues to be the world's largest arms
importer due to the abysmal performance
of DRDO and its 52 labs, four defence
shipyards, five defence PSUs and 41
ordnance factories;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
delegation of more powers to DRDO was
intended to neutralise the ill effect of over
centralisation and facilitate quicker decision
making; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Encouraging students to join NCC
1447. SARDAR SUKHDEV SINGH
DHINDSA: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) various steps undertaken by
Government to motivate and encourage
students to join National Cadet Corps
(NCC) in schools and colleges; and
(b) details of facilities provided to
students to join NCC?
Attracting youth to Armed Forces
1448. SARDAR BALWINDER
SINGH BHUNDER: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Armed Forces
is facing a shortage of around 9000 officers,
despite a concerted drive to attract youth
of the country to don the uniform;
(b) whether Government has been able
to find out the reason thereof;

335
(c) whether it is a fact that there is lack
of promotion prospects in the Armed
Forces; and
(d) if so,  whether  it is possible to
overcome the situation?
Status of DRDO projects
1449. SHRI T. RATHINA VEL: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that over
` 2.65 lakh crore worth of products
inducted or under process of induction into
military are produced or are proposed to
be produced by DRDO;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that most
projects were hit by huge time and cost
overruns; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Disbandment of Defence workshops
